title: mcpx: port the opencode plugin to opencode v2 (a rewrite, and several things get better)

body:
Relocated from dezren39/nix#47 on 2026-10-28 (placement audit): mcpx's single source lives in developing-today/code (pkgs/mcpx); re-home tracked at #309. Original body below; issue references inside it are historical (dezren39/nix numbering).

Parent: #181

Backlog. Findings: `pkgs/mcpx/docs/opencode-plugin.md` §2 and §4.

**v1 plugins do not load in opencode v2** — no shim, no fallback (`packages/core/src/plugin/module.ts:60-73`). v2 needs a rewrite against `{id, setup}`, not a port.

What changes, each better than the v1 equivalent:

| v1 today | v2 |
| --- | --- |
| `shell.env` per command (carries sessionID) | `shell.create.before` has **no sessionID** → use `PUT /api/experimental/session/:id/environment` once per session |
| `experimental.chat.system.transform` | `session.hook("context")` → `event.system` (or a budgeted catalog in `event.tools`, diffed between turns) |
| `tool` map, un-namespaced | `tool.transform(e => e.add(...))` with a namespace |
| `tool.execute.after` sees success only | union on `status` — record failures too |
| state file for the remembered daemon | `ctx.storage` |
| no way to answer MCP sampling | `ctx.generate.text` — the plugin can answer mcpx's sampling questions |
| `$` for the CLI | gone — and nothing is lost: since #53 (closes #44) the plugin reaches the daemon over the unix socket and spawns `mcpx --json status` only as rung 4, the last fallback (`plugin/opencode/README.md:83-110`, `plugin/opencode/mcpx/daemon.ts`); `backend: v1` never spawns and `bin: ""` forbids it. In v2, drop rung 4 or keep it through `node:child_process`, which `daemon.ts` already imports |
| subdirectory to hide helpers from the loader | unnecessary; only `default` is read |

Also new in v2 and worth using: `mcp.transform` (register a *filtered* server set per session), `permission.hook("evaluate")` (real, unlike v1's dead `permission.ask`), promise-based TUI `select()` for the daemon picker.

**Also:** opencode v2's MCP client sends `_meta["ai.opencode/sessionID"]` on tool calls (`packages/core/src/mcp/client.ts:278`). When opencode v2 talks to mcpx as an MCP server, mcpx should read that for session attribution and leasing — no environment injection needed at all on that path.

Depends on: #44 (closed, fixed in #53 — the binary-free core exists).

Since this was filed (checked at 05c78b2):

- **#171's guard covers a v2 port automatically.** `TestThePluginReadsNoUndeclaredSetting`
  (`internal/settings/consumed_test.go:209-236`) scans every `plugin/**/*.ts(x)` except tests
  (`pluginSources`, `:288-320`), so a v2 plugin anywhere under `plugin/` must honour only variables declared in
  `pluginSettings()` (`internal/settings/plugin.go:18`). #171 also wired `plugin.discoveryRetry` and declared
  `plugin.remember`/`plugin.annotate`; the v2 port keeps all three.
- **The dead `permission.ask` hook** is recorded among the "declared but did nothing" incidents
  (`docs/declared-but-unread.md:8-12`, #75's PR body); nothing in the v1 plugin is built on it
  (`docs/plugin-discovery.md:144-145`). v2's `permission.hook("evaluate")` is the real one.
- The opencode-side line references above (`packages/core/src/plugin/module.ts:60-73`,
  `packages/core/src/mcp/client.ts:278`) are against opencode's `v2` branch and were not re-checked in this pass.

No real choice: v1 plugins do not load in v2, so the only question is when. The table above is the design.

## Ease · Impact · Related

**Ease** L (a rewrite against `{id, setup}`, not a port) · **Impact** med-high — nil while v1 is what runs,
total once v2 is (the v1 plugin does not load at all).

Related: #48 (the harness-free core this adapter sits on), #80 and #82 (the extension side; the same `/v1`
back-channel), #87 (`ctx.storage` replaces the remembered-daemon file; its lifetime follows #87's rule).

Security/auth deferred; see tracker.
